name: Nabelcus

attributes.attribute: Roman warrior god linked to Nabelcus

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nabelcus was a Continental Celtic god. He came from the Vaucluse region of France. The Romans linked this obscure divinity with their warrior god Mars. Few other details about him survive.
